import pandas as pd

# Source file paths
source_files = [
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length1_87/training_0.csv"
]

# List to hold dataframes from all sources
dfs = []

# Load each source CSV file with index_col=0 to ignore the first numerical index column
for file_path in source_files:
    df = pd.read_csv(file_path, index_col=0)
    dfs.append(df)

# Since all source tables have the same schema as the target ['condition', 'click'],
# and target examples show no transformation other than type casting,
# we can union (concatenate) all source tables directly.

# Concatenate all source dataframes vertically (union)
combined_df = pd.concat(dfs, ignore_index=True)

# Ensure the target schema and types:
# 'condition': integer
# 'click': float
combined_df = combined_df.astype({'condition': 'int64', 'click': 'float64'})

# Write the combined dataframe to the target CSV file path
output_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_87/target_multisource.csv"
combined_df.to_csv(output_path, index=False)
